workDetails.description: Built SRE Assistant, an AI assistant that helps investigate issues within each project's scope by reviewing the codebase and Grafana telemetry.
workDetails.descriptionId: Membangun SRE Assistant, AI assistant yang membantu investigasi issue sesuai scope project dengan memeriksa codebase dan telemetry di Grafana.

workDetails.description: Set up Grafana alerts and automated notifications to support issue monitoring.
workDetails.descriptionId: Menyiapkan alert Grafana dan notifikasi otomatis untuk membantu monitoring issue.

workDetails.description: Automated data validation and reporting to Google Docs to support routine operational checks.
workDetails.descriptionId: Mengotomatisasi data validation dan pembuatan report ke Google Docs untuk mendukung pengecekan operasional rutin.

workDetails.description: Wrote scripts to automatically check data synchronization between PostgreSQL and Elasticsearch and identify inconsistencies.
workDetails.descriptionId: Membuat script untuk mengecek sinkronisasi data PostgreSQL dan Elasticsearch secara otomatis serta mengidentifikasi inkonsistensi data.

workDetails.description: Handled client issue tickets, including investigating issues, documenting root-cause analysis (RCA), and creating hotfixes.
workDetails.descriptionId: Menangani ticket issue dari klien, mulai dari investigasi issue, penyusunan dokumen root-cause analysis (RCA), hingga pembuatan hotfix.

workDetails.description: Handled application deployments using Kubernetes.
workDetails.descriptionId: Menangani deployment aplikasi menggunakan Kubernetes.

workDetails.description: Created GitLab CI/CD pipelines to automate security checks.
workDetails.descriptionId: Membuat pipeline GitLab CI/CD untuk menjalankan security checks secara otomatis.

workDetails.description: Developed eVoucher features for MyPertamina covering BBM Product and Source of Fund CRUD APIs, program redeem rules and validation, and an isTransferrable configuration to control voucher transfers.
workDetails.descriptionId: Mengembangkan fitur eVoucher untuk MyPertamina yang mencakup API CRUD BBM Product dan Source of Fund, konfigurasi dan validasi redeem rule pada program, serta pengaturan isTransferrable untuk mengontrol transfer voucher.

workDetails.description: Rebuilt the core SaaS authentication service in Go within one month, replacing an end-of-life Node.js v10 runtime while preserving backward compatibility, addressing legacy security vulnerabilities, and enabling new features.
workDetails.descriptionId: Membangun ulang layanan authentication inti SaaS menggunakan Go dalam satu bulan untuk menggantikan runtime Node.js v10 yang sudah end-of-life. Migrasi ini mempertahankan backward compatibility, mengatasi celah keamanan lama, dan mendukung pengembangan fitur baru.

workDetails.description: Maintained and scaled the SaaS background worker monorepo, covering asynchronous runners, batch customer rewards, and atomic card balance and wallet unification.
workDetails.descriptionId: Mengelola dan mengembangkan monorepo background worker SaaS untuk asynchronous runner, pemrosesan reward pelanggan secara batch, serta penyatuan saldo kartu dan wallet secara atomic.

workDetails.description: Built Custom Variant Order support and batch catalog categorization in the inventory microservice, including high-cardinality SKU search, multi-attribute product variants, and streaming catalog exports. Optimized query plans for heavy merchant read traffic.
workDetails.descriptionId: Membangun fitur Custom Variant Order dan kategorisasi katalog secara batch pada microservice inventory, termasuk pencarian SKU dengan cardinality tinggi, varian produk multi-attribute, dan streaming export katalog. Mengoptimalkan query plan untuk menangani read traffic merchant yang tinggi.

workDetails.description: Designed and shipped Fraud Manager v2 in under two weeks. Replaced hardcoded fraud rules with a dashboard where operations teams can configure transaction thresholds, auto-lock triggers, and rejection rules without a code deployment, helping reduce financial risk.
workDetails.descriptionId: Merancang dan merilis Fraud Manager v2 dalam waktu kurang dari dua minggu. Mengganti fraud rule yang hardcoded dengan dashboard agar tim operasional bisa mengatur transaction threshold, auto-lock trigger, dan rejection rule tanpa deployment kode, sehingga membantu mengurangi risiko kerugian finansial.

workDetails.description: Designed a real-time aggregation pipeline with Debezium CDC and Apache Kafka to synchronize data across microservices into a single source of truth, resolving data inconsistencies and improving reporting accuracy.
workDetails.descriptionId: Merancang pipeline agregasi real-time dengan Debezium CDC dan Apache Kafka untuk menyinkronkan data antar-microservice ke satu single source of truth, mengatasi inkonsistensi data, dan meningkatkan akurasi laporan.

workDetails.description: Built a WhatsApp template creation API supporting multiple vendors, including vFirst, Meta, and Bahasa AI.
workDetails.descriptionId: Membangun API untuk membuat template WhatsApp yang mendukung beberapa vendor, termasuk vFirst, Meta, dan Bahasa AI.

workDetails.description: Built a WhatsApp login flow where users request a login link through the TADA WhatsApp chatbot, with request validation and secure token generation to reduce OTP costs.
workDetails.descriptionId: Membangun login flow melalui WhatsApp, di mana user secara aktif meminta link login lewat chatbot WhatsApp TADA. Flow ini mencakup validasi request dan generate token secara secure untuk mengurangi biaya OTP.

workDetails.description: Implemented sensitive data masking across API endpoints.
workDetails.descriptionId: Menerapkan masking untuk sensitive data di berbagai API endpoint.

workDetails.description: Handled secure card and balance migration flows, addressing race conditions and using the saga pattern to recover from service failures.
workDetails.descriptionId: Menangani card migration flow dan migrasi saldo user secara secure, termasuk mengatasi race condition dan menggunakan saga pattern untuk recovery saat terjadi service failure.

workDetails.description: Implemented a new hold status for eVouchers to help reduce fraud.
workDetails.descriptionId: Menerapkan status hold baru pada eVoucher untuk membantu mengurangi fraud.

workDetails.description: Handled eVoucher distribution through WhatsApp, email, and SMS using an event-driven system with a focus on delivery performance.
workDetails.descriptionId: Menangani distribusi eVoucher melalui WhatsApp, email, dan SMS menggunakan event-driven system dengan fokus pada performance pengiriman.

workDetails.description: Handled payment transaction verification and reconciliation across Midtrans, Xendit, and Billplz, checking transaction status when webhooks failed to arrive to keep internal payment records aligned with gateway data.
workDetails.descriptionId: Menangani verifikasi dan rekonsiliasi transaksi pembayaran di Midtrans, Xendit, dan Billplz, dengan mengecek status transaksi saat webhook gagal diterima agar data pembayaran internal tetap sesuai dengan data payment gateway.

workDetails.description: Integrated logistics APIs from GoSend, Lalamove, SiCepat, and Shipper, from specification review through production rollout, to automate delivery fulfillment.
workDetails.descriptionId: Menangani integrasi API logistik GoSend, Lalamove, SiCepat, dan Shipper, dari review spesifikasi hingga rollout ke production, untuk mengotomatisasi fulfillment pengiriman.

workDetails.description: Integrated fulfillment using Tokopedia for physical items, alongside digital fulfillment APIs for RajaBiller, BPJS, mobile data, and gold products, to automate fulfillment and expand the product catalog.
workDetails.descriptionId: Menangani integrasi fulfillment menggunakan Tokopedia untuk barang fisik, serta API digital fulfillment untuk RajaBiller, BPJS, paket data, dan produk emas, untuk mengotomatisasi fulfillment dan memperluas katalog produk.

workDetails.description: Integrated vFirst messaging APIs to support automated message delivery.
workDetails.descriptionId: Mengintegrasikan API messaging vFirst untuk mendukung pengiriman pesan otomatis.

workDetails.description: Integrated Lark APIs to automate internal operational workflows.
workDetails.descriptionId: Mengintegrasikan API Lark untuk mengotomatisasi workflow operasional internal.

workDetails.description: Built Fokoline, a web booking platform for printing and photocopy services, from architecture and relational database design through checkout flows and production deployment.
workDetails.descriptionId: Membangun Fokoline, platform web untuk pemesanan jasa percetakan dan fotokopi, mulai dari desain arsitektur dan relational database hingga checkout flow dan deployment ke production.

workDetails.description: Built responsive, accessible landing pages and custom web modules with Laravel and JavaScript, improving load times and meeting client requirements.
workDetails.descriptionId: Membangun landing page yang responsive dan accessible serta modul web custom menggunakan Laravel dan JavaScript, dengan optimasi load time sesuai kebutuhan klien.

workDetails.description: Delivered 2+ enterprise systems for government agencies, replacing manual administrative processes with automated workflows and digital official correspondence management.
workDetails.descriptionId: Menyelesaikan 2+ sistem enterprise untuk instansi pemerintah, mengubah proses administrasi manual menjadi workflow otomatis dan pengelolaan surat dinas digital.

workDetails.description: Built real-time budget monitoring dashboards for a ministry finance bureau to track spending against quarterly budget realization targets.
workDetails.descriptionId: Membangun dashboard monitoring penyerapan anggaran secara real-time untuk biro keuangan kementerian agar tim bisa memantau pencapaian target realisasi anggaran setiap kuartal.

workDetails.description: Designed normalized relational database schemas in PostgreSQL and MySQL to support analytical reports across multiple tables for public sector systems.
workDetails.descriptionId: Merancang schema relational database dengan normalisasi di PostgreSQL dan MySQL untuk mendukung laporan analitik lintas tabel pada sistem instansi pemerintah.

workDetails.description: Developed a platform for the Ministry of Tourism to manage Dana Alokasi Khusus (DAK), enabling regional government offices across Indonesia to submit, validate, and audit budget proposals.
workDetails.descriptionId: Mengembangkan platform pengelolaan Dana Alokasi Khusus (DAK) untuk Kementerian Pariwisata, sehingga dinas daerah di seluruh Indonesia bisa mengajukan, memvalidasi, dan mengaudit proposal anggaran.

workDetails.description: Built operational monitoring dashboards to track distributed service status and system health.
workDetails.descriptionId: Membangun dashboard monitoring operasional untuk memantau status distributed service dan system health.

workDetails.description: Integrated external systems through SynchroX middleware to automate data synchronization and enable data exchange across platforms.
workDetails.descriptionId: Mengintegrasikan sistem eksternal melalui middleware SynchroX untuk mengotomatisasi sinkronisasi data dan mendukung pertukaran data antar-platform.
